title: The merge tool enforces the batch freeze: `merge --batch-build` freezes the lane set, `--batch-drop` drops one lane with no re-check
why: Owner, 20:30 CST Nov 8 in triage chat ("mechanically enforce this") and 20:31 CST to the coordinator ("mechanize the batch freeze fix ASAP"), on the batch freeze from step batch-freeze-lane-set.
note: Filed by triage, Nov 8 20:32 CST. An owner ask. Builds merge --batch-build (freezes the set of lanes ready at first build; a later lane goes to the next batch) and --batch-drop (drops one lane on red with no re-check). Step batch-freeze-lane-set (#2367) stays prose. Sighting (coordinator, 05:46 CST Nov 9): the lane for #2199 and #2327 (session_013NEJL1YxsYqim39RK6JeZP) merged main into both and pushed new heads (39432db98, 63d71001a) while both sat in batch 68 (#2426) with CI running. Nothing refused a push to a branch inside a running batch. Owner pick on the waiting page (13:09 CST Nov 9): item 458 a. One settings edit adds `--batch-build`, `--batch-drop` and `--ready` to the merge tool's allow rule. The owner chose it although it carries the label "Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo", so the pick is the owner's word for this act only. Follow-up lane (coordinator 02:11 CST Nov 10): swap FREEZE_CITE to decision batch-freeze-lane-set.
